title: [LOGGED IN] Buying a Loyalty shop item without enough points shows a "not enough points" message
reason: All answers matched; message "Not enough loyalty points. Earn more by making purchases." shown, balance unchanged at 40.

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store?user-id={TEST_USER_ID} in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss". If a "Login successful" popup is shown, click "Ok".
steps.saw: Cookie banner dismissed; no Login successful popup.

steps.text: Does the header show the green "Player{TEST_USER_ID}" button, and no "Login" button?
steps.saw: Green Player{TEST_USER_ID} button with balances 0 and 40, no Login button.
Page scrolled to the Loyalty shop section.

steps.text: Wait 2 seconds until the page stops scrolling.
steps.saw: Waited 2 seconds; Loyalty shop cards visible.

steps.text: Is at least one Loyalty shop price higher than the teal loyalty points balance in the header? (precondition)
Is the teal loyalty points balance shown in the header (note the number as the "before" value)?
Click the green point price button of the cheapest Loyalty shop card whose price is higher than the balance.
steps.saw: Clicked the 160 button on the Handful of dice card (cheapest price, 160 > 40).

steps.text: Is a message shown that says there are not enough points (or the purchase is refused)?
steps.saw: Toast: "Not enough loyalty points. Earn more by making purchases."

steps.text: If a popup is shown, close it with its close button.
steps.saw: Closed the message with its X (Close) button.

steps.text: Is the teal loyalty points balance in the header the same as before?

steps.saw: Only one tab open, no payment window.
